## 1. Test Matrix by User Flow

### Flow F01: Feed Consumption & Engagement

| Case ID | Type | Action / Trigger | Expected Result | Pass / Fail |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **F01-H1** | Happy | Open app at `/` | First video plays automatically with audio muted (policy compliant); video fills viewport. | **PASS** |
| **F01-H2** | Happy | Click/Tap mute button HUD | Video audio un-mutes smoothly without pausing or buffering. | **PASS** |
| **F01-H3** | Happy | Single click/tap anywhere on video surface | Video pauses instantly and displays animated center Play indicator. Second tap resumes. | **PASS** |
| **F01-H4** | Happy | Double click/tap video surface | Floating heart bursts at click coordinates; heart icon fills red; like counter increments by 1. | **PASS** |
| **F01-H5** | Happy | Click down navigation button | Smooth scroll transition to Video 2; Video 2 auto-plays; previous video resets. | **PASS** |
| **F01-E1** | Edge | Double click on Heart icon rapidly (5 times) | Idempotent toggle; counter only increments or decrements cleanly by 1 (no integer corruption). | **PASS** |
| **F01-E2** | Edge | Rapid vertical paging up & down | Video decoders release properly; no memory runaway or audio overlap across tracks. | **PASS** |

### Flow F02: Comment Drawer Interactions

| Case ID | Type | Action / Trigger | Expected Result | Pass / Fail |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **F02-H1** | Happy | Click Comment icon on action rail | Slide-up drawer opens from bottom covering 65% of viewport; shows comment list and input bar. | **PASS** |
| **F02-H2** | Happy | Type comment and submit form | New comment appears at top of drawer; comment counter increments; input field clears. | **PASS** |
| **F02-H3** | Happy | Click close button (X) | Drawer slides down and dismisses; video playback remains uninterrupted. | **PASS** |
| **F02-E1** | Edge | Submit empty comment or whitespace only | Submit button remains disabled; form submission blocked. | **PASS** |
| **F02-E2** | Edge | Submit very long text (500+ characters) | Input box auto-wraps; comment text displays without breaking container bounds. | **PASS** |
